releaseNotes: Neutrino Cyber Jukebox & YouTube Engine: Full direct YouTube / YouTube Music search and background streaming with zero advertisements, zero audio interruptions, and instant auto-skipping.

Ultra-Compact Quantum Reactor Minimize Badge: Completely redesigned 34dp static obsidian reactor badge in both portrait and landscape with zero idle CPU overdraw and smooth hardware-accelerated edge snapping.
WhatsApp Community Integration: Direct access to the official Game Nuke WhatsApp community channel in the dashboard footer and navigation drawer.
Extreme Low-RAM Architecture: Offscreen 1x1 audio rendering engine without heavy GPU surfaces, reducing memory footprint to <20MB and ensuring zero gaming lag or frame drops.
Neutrino Neural Telemetry AI Core: Real-time autonomous hardware telemetry, cognitive bottleneck analysis, and low-latency kernel performance tuning.
Professional eSports Sensi Panel: Calibrated hardware touch calibration with custom response curves and 1.00x pure linear pass-through without cheat presets.
Absolute Zero-Ghost Touch Protection: Hardware kernel BTN_TOUCH release detection guarantees instant pointer purge with zero phantom taps.

Universal Brand Compatibility: Fully audited and validated across HyperOS/MIUI (Xiaomi/POCO), One UI (Samsung), ColorOS/OxygenOS (Oppo/Realme/OnePlus), FuntouchOS (Vivo/iQOO), ROG UI (ASUS), and Stock AOSP (Google Pixel) on Android 11 through Android 16.
